name: Azure Event Hubs
sku: Azure Event Hubs, Standard, Premium and Dedicated tiers.

source.event-stream.note: A fully managed event streaming platform. Producers send events over Apache Kafka, AMQP 1.0 or HTTPS into partitioned, append-only logs, with retention of up to 7 days on Standard and 90 days on Premium and Dedicated.

ingest.stream-ingest.note: Ingests millions of events per second with low latency, and Capture writes the stream to Blob Storage or Data Lake Storage in near real time for long-term retention.

bands.note: Azure Monitor metrics, diagnostic logs and alerts track throughput, latency, errors and consumer lag.

presentation.tagline: Managed event streaming with Kafka compatibility.
